subject: Sprint Zero onboarding: API creds, org setup, IP allow-list & peering cadence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Russo <alex@halcyonhealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@healthventures.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-05-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Sprint Zero: POC environment kickoff & runbook

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for confirming the POC window. To keep momentum in Sprint Zero, here's a concise kickoff checklist that we'll own collaboratively in the MAP. Goal is to have a sandbox environment ready for org-level tests by Week 2 so you can run latency and throughput checks.

Minimum runbook items:
- Org & tenant setup (we create the Redwood org; you confirm admin users)
- API keys & scoped service principals (short-lived keys for the POC)
- IP allow-list for API endpoints (we'll provide base IPs, you provide CIDR blocks)
- VPC peering (cross-account peering; non-production CIDR to avoid conflicts)
- Test dataset handoff and sample prompts (small volume)

I've attached a MAP draft and a VPC diagram to help the cloud team. Can you confirm: 1) the Halcyon cloud contact for peering, 2) preferred peering window (UTC), and 3) whether you need BGP or static routes?

Attachments: map-draft-v1.pdf, vpc-peering-diagram.png

Next steps (short):
1) Alex — share cloudops contact + CIDR by EOD today
2) Neha — provide IP allow-list template and typical port requirements
3) Irene/Ben — finalize MAP milestones & sign-off doc

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m call if helpful.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

- We can provide CIDR blocks for a staging VPC (10.44.0.0/16). Will that work?
- We prefer a peering window 02:00–04:00 UTC (low traffic).
- No BGP required for this POC; static routing is fine.

I will loop in our cloudops alias (cloudops@halcyonhealth.com) after confirming with the team.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Russo <alex@halcyonhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-05-29T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint Zero: POC environment kickoff & runbook — technical checklist

Hi all — attaching a short checklist and an allow-list template to speed things up. Key items from infra/security: 
- API endpoints: 52.14.120.0/22 (redwood-prod-edge) and 34.98.200.0/23 (redwood-sandbox-edge). Add these to your allow-list for outbound calls.
- Allowed ports: 443 (HTTPS), 80 (HTTP for healthchecks), 22 (optional, for support—request by exception).
- VPC peering: exchange VPC IDs + account IDs; no overlapping CIDRs (10.44.0.0/16 OK).
- Route propagation: we require static routes on both sides for the POC; no BGP.
- IAM/scoped API keys: we'll mint short-lived keys tied to the MAP and rotate after 30 days.

Attachments: allowlist-template.csv

Timeline suggestion for MAP milestones:
- T+0 (today): Confirm cloudops contact and CIDR (Alex)
- T+1 business day: Peering request submitted + allow-list completed (Halcyon)
- T+2 business days: Peering established & short-lived API keys issued (Redwood)
- T+3–T+5: Sanity checks, sample prompt runs, and perf baseline collection

Ping me if you want the peering playbook (I can forward the step-by-step).

—Neha
Neha Kapoor | Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
[attachment: allowlist-template.csv]
